name: app-health
description: App Health V0 — endpoint health for Go and Node applications.

scripts.check: pnpm --silent run format:check && pnpm --silent run lint && pnpm --silent run typecheck && pnpm --silent run test && pnpm --silent run build
scripts.deploy:dry-run: pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @app-health/worker exec wrangler deploy --env="" --dry-run
scripts.d1:migrate:production: pnpm run deploy:guard && pnpm --filter @app-health/worker exec wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote --env=""
scripts.deploy: pnpm run deploy:guard && pnpm run build && pnpm --filter @app-health/worker exec wrangler deploy --env=""
